assessment: This article, which is of interest to membrane biologists and colleagues in signal transduction, examines the interesting question of whether LRRK2 recruitment to membranes may regulate its activity. Membrane association involves binding to membrane-tethered Rab GTPases via LRRK2's Armadillo domain, and the authors provide an exciting and elegant feed-forward mechanism to describe how recruitment of phospho-RAB8 can promote phosphorylation of RAB10.
